units.source_text: 翌年四月间，源氏公子想起了花散里，便向紫姬招呼了一声，悄悄地前去访问。

en.t: In the fourth month of the following year, Prince Genji thought of Hanachirusato, mentioned it to Lady Murasaki, and quietly went to visit her.

units.source_text: 连日天雨，至今犹有余滴。

en.t: It had been raining for days, and even now a few lingering drops still fell.

units.source_text: 但天色渐霁，云间露出月亮来。

en.t: But the sky was gradually clearing, and the moon appeared through the clouds.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想起了昔日微行时的光景，便在这清艳的月夜一路上追思种种往事。

en.t: Prince Genji remembered the scenes of his secret outings in former days, and throughout that clear, beautiful moonlit night he recalled many things from the past.

units.source_text: 忽然经过一所邸宅，已经荒芜得不成样子，庭中树木丛茂，竟像一座森林。

en.t: Suddenly he passed a mansion that had fallen into terrible ruin, its garden trees growing so thickly that it looked like a forest.

units.source_text: 一株高大的松树上挂着藤花，映着月光，随风飘过一阵幽香，引人怀念。

en.t: Wisteria blossoms hung from a tall pine tree, shining in the moonlight, and a faint fragrance drifted on the wind, stirring memories.

units.source_text: 这香气与橘花又不相同，另有一种情趣。

en.t: This fragrance was different from that of orange blossoms and had a charm all its own.

units.source_text: 公子从车窗中探头一望，但见那些杨柳挂着长条，坍塌的垣墙遮挡它不住，让它自由自在地披在上面。

en.t: The prince looked out from the carriage window and saw willows trailing their long branches; the collapsed wall could not hold them back, and they draped freely over it.

units.source_text: 他觉得这些树木似乎是曾经见过的，原来这便是末摘花的宫邸。

en.t: He felt that he had seen these trees before, and realized that this was the residence of Suetsumuhana.

units.source_text: 源氏公子深觉可怜，便命停车。

en.t: Prince Genji was deeply moved with pity and ordered the carriage to stop.

units.source_text: 每次微行，总少不了惟光。

en.t: Whenever he went out secretly, Koremitsu was always with him.

units.source_text: 此次这个人也在身边。

en.t: This time too, the man was at his side.

units.source_text: 公子便问他：“这是已故常陆亲王的宫邸么？”

en.t: The prince asked him, Is this the residence of the late Prince of Hitachi?

units.source_text: 惟光答道：“正是。”

en.t: Koremitsu replied, It is.

units.source_text: 公子说：“他家那个人，想必依旧寂寞无聊地住在里面吧？

en.t: The prince said, The lady of this house must still be living inside, lonely and weary as ever, must she not?

units.source_text: 我想去探访一下。

en.t: I would like to go and call on her.

units.source_text: 特地前来，也太费事。

en.t: It would be too much trouble to come here specially for that.

units.source_text: 今日乘便，你替我进去通报一下吧。

en.t: Since we are passing by today, go in for me and announce my visit.

units.source_text: 要问清楚了，然后说出我的名字来！

en.t: Make sure you have the right place first, and then give them my name.

units.source_text: 倘使弄错了人家，太冒失了。”

en.t: If we have mistaken the household, it would be terribly rash.
